evals.prompt: update the plugin to the latest version
evals.expected_output: Runs install.sh, compares versions, reports result and restart instructions
expectations: Captures current version from plugin.json before running update
Compares old and new versions and reports the difference
Instructs user to restart Claude Code if version changed

evals.expected_output: Runs the update process and reports version comparison
expectations: Recognizes 'upgrade harness' as an update request
Reports whether the version changed or was already current

evals.expected_output: Runs install.sh to check and apply any available updates
expectations: Treats 'check for updates' as an update trigger

evals.prompt: update plugin but CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is not set
evals.expected_output: Reports that the plugin root is not configured and stops
expectations: Detects that CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is not set
Reports the plugin is not properly installed
Does not attempt to run install.sh

evals.prompt: get latest version of the harness
evals.expected_output: Runs the update flow and reports version status
expectations: Recognizes 'get latest version' as an update trigger
Reports old vs new version comparison
